title: Independent AI researcher
summary: Teaching machines to understand how people move and interact - where two bodies touch and how their limbs entangle - with jiu-jitsu as the test. One paper accepted, a public repo for every thread, and the negative results kept.

title: The mats
summary: Sold Dehidden on a Friday. First jiu-jitsu class on the Monday. Then a year of training six days a week, a training camp, and two competitions.
